name: memo-insert-private
source:
import copy
shared=[]
class Hook:
 def __deepcopy__(self,memo):memo[id(shared)]='replacement';return self
result=copy.deepcopy([Hook(),shared])

copy-dictionary-hook-order
source:
import copy
events=[]
class K:
 def __hash__(self):return 1
 def __deepcopy__(self,memo):events.append('key');return self
class V:
 def __deepcopy__(self,memo):events.append('value');return self
copy.deepcopy({K():V()})
print(events)

name: deepcopy-defaultdict-order-control
source:
import copy
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
events=[]
class K:
 def __hash__(self):return 1
 def __deepcopy__(self,memo):events.append('key');return self
class V:
 def __deepcopy__(self,memo):events.append('value');return self
mapping=defaultdict(None);mapping[K()]=V();copy.deepcopy(mapping);print(events)
